## 1. Start with the Test Records
You should always start with the test records for the appliance that has failed the Electrical Safety Test. These records should already exist within your PAT testing system.

## 2. Select the “Failed” Test Record
Select the test record that indicates the appliance has failed the safety test.  The record will include the appliance ID, the date of the test, the tester’s details, and the test results. It will also show what tests have failed.
   *   **Reference Number:** Ensure you accurately record the appliance's unique reference number from the test record.
   *   **Date of Test:** Note the date when the test was conducted.

## 3. Take Photos of the Identified Fault(s)
